fullText.simplified:
惩罚

    二龙神慢慢地说：“华三，如果你不把宝莲灯给我，我就带着你的孩子回天上去。你没有受到的惩罚，都会落到这个孩子身上，你愿意吗？”
    华三的眼泪掉下来了，她说：“我把宝莲灯给你。”
    “很好。”二龙神笑了。
    宝莲灯出现了，华三挥了挥手，它飘到了二龙神面前。二龙神伸手，拿到了宝莲灯。
    “孩子给你！”二龙神把成香扔给了华三。
    成香还在睡觉，华三抱着他，看着他胖胖的脸蛋，难过得说不出话。过了一会儿，她把孩子交给刘向，流着泪说：“没有了宝莲灯，我打不过我哥哥。我们的孩子就交给你了，你要好好照顾他，让他平安长大。”
    刘向难过地说：“成香不能没有母亲，我也不能没有你。”
    二龙神不耐烦地看着他们，说：“华三！我最后一次问你，你愿意跟我回天上去吗？”
    华三不再流泪，她回头看着二龙神，给了他最后的回答：“我不能离开我的孩子和丈夫。”
    二龙神摇了摇头，他把刀举起，对着华三挥了过来。
    华三和二龙神又打起来了，他们在黑色的天上打来打去。很快，刘向就看不到他们了。过了一会儿，天边飘来一朵巨大的云，把天都要盖住了。刘向睁大眼睛，看清楚了——那不是云，而是一座大山！
    大山从东边飘来，又飘了回去。然后，一声巨大的响声，像是有什么东西重重地压在了地上。周围一片安静，所有的声音都消失了。
    刘向着急地看着黑色的天空，大声喊华三的名字，但是他没有听到华三的回答。远处的天空里飘来二龙神冰冷的声音：“华三，这是你不遵守天规的惩罚，这座华山会永远压在你身上。”
    刘向抱着成香一下子坐到了地上，难过地大哭起来。
    华三回不来了，她被一座大山压住了，她被压在了华山下面。
fullText.traditional:
懲罰

    二龍神慢慢地說：“華三，如果你不把寳蓮燈給我，我就帶著你的孩子回天上去。你沒有受到的懲罰，都會落到這個孩子身上，你願意嗎？”
    華三的眼淚掉下來了，她說：“我把寳蓮燈給你。”
    “很好。”二龍神笑了。
    寳蓮燈出現了，華三揮了揮手，它飄到了二龍神面前。二龍神伸手，拿到了寳蓮燈。
    “孩子給你！”二龍神把成香扔給了華三。
    成香還在睡覺，華三抱著他，看著他胖胖的臉蛋，難過得說不出話。過了一會兒，她把孩子交給劉向，流著淚說：“沒有了寳蓮燈，我打不過我哥哥。我們的孩子就交給你了，你要好好照顧他，讓他平安長大。”
    劉向難過地說：“成香不能沒有母親，我也不能沒有你。”
    二龍神不耐煩地看著他們，說：“華三！我最後一次問你，你願意跟我回天上去嗎？”
    華三不再流淚，她回頭看著二龍神，給了他最後的回答：“我不能離開我的孩子和丈夫。”
    二龍神搖了搖頭，他把刀舉起，對著華三揮了過來。
    華三和二龍神又打起來了，他們在黑色的天上打來打去。很快，劉向就看不到他們了。過了一會兒，天邊飄來一朵巨大的雲，把天都要蓋住了。劉向睜大眼睛，看清楚了——那不是雲，而是一座大山！
    大山從東邊飄來，又飄了回去。然後，一聲巨大的響聲，像是有什麼東西重重地壓在了地上。周圍一片安靜，所有的聲音都消失了。
    劉向著急地看著黑色的天空，大聲喊華三的名字，但是他沒有聽到華三的回答。遠處的天空裡飄來二龍神冰冷的聲音：“華三，這是你不遵守天規的懲罰，這座華山會永遠壓在你身上。”
    劉向抱著成香一下子坐到了地上，難過地大哭起來。
    華三回不來了，她被一座大山壓住了，她被壓在了華山下面。

sentences.english: Hua San shed no more tears. She looked back at Erlong Shen and gave him her final answer: “I can’t leave my child and my husband.”

sentences.simplified: 二龙神摇了摇头，他把刀举起，对着华三挥了过来。

sentences.english: Erlong Shen shook his head, raised his sword, and swung it toward Hua San.

sentences.simplified: 华三和二龙神又打起来了，他们在黑色的天上打来打去。

sentences.english: Soon Liu Xiang couldn’t see them. After a while, a huge cloud came floating over, covering the sky.

sentences.simplified: 刘向睁大眼睛，看清楚了——那不是云，而是一座大山！

sentences.english: Liu Xiang opened his eyes wide to see clearly⁠—it was not a cloud, but a big mountain!

sentences.simplified: 大山从东边飘来，又飘了回去。
sentences.traditional: 大山從東邊飄來，又飄了回去。
sentences.pinyin: dà shān cóng dōng bian piāo lái yòu piāo le huí qù

sentences.traditional: 然後，一聲巨大的響聲，像是有什麼東西重重地壓在了地上。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu yì shēng jù dà de xiǎng shēng xiàng shì yǒu shén me dōng xi zhòng zhòng de yā zài le dì shang
sentences.english: Then there was a loud bang as if something had been pressed down heavily on the ground.

sentences.simplified: 周围一片安静，所有的声音都消失了。
sentences.traditional: 周圍一片安靜，所有的聲音都消失了。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu wéi yí piàn ān jìng suǒ yǒu de shēng yīn dōu xiāo shī le
sentences.english: Then there was silence all around. All the sounds had gone.

sentences.traditional: 劉向著急地看著黑色的天空，大聲喊華三的名字，但是他沒有聽到華三的回答。
sentences.pinyin: liú xiàng zháo jí de kàn zhe hēi sè de tiān kōng dà shēng hǎn huà sān de míng zi dàn shì tā méi yǒu tīng dào huà sān de huí dá
sentences.english: Liu Xiang looked anxiously at the black sky and shouted Hua San’s name, but he didn’t hear Hua San’s answer.

sentences.english: The icy voice of Erlong Shen came floating from the distant sky:

sentences.traditional: “華三，這是你不遵守天規的懲罰，這座華山會永遠壓在你身上。”

sentences.english: “Hua San, this is your punishment for not obeying the rules of heaven. This Mount Hua will be on top of you forever.”

sentences.simplified: 刘向抱着成香一下子坐到了地上，难过地大哭起来。
sentences.traditional: 劉向抱著成香一下子坐到了地上，難過地大哭起來。
sentences.pinyin: liú xiàng bào zhe chéng xiāng yí xià zi zuò dào le dì shang nán guò de dà kū qǐ lái
sentences.english: Liu Xiang held Chengxiang and suddenly sat down. He started crying sadly.

sentences.simplified: 华三回不来了，她被一座大山压住了，她被压在了华山下面。
sentences.traditional: 華三回不來了，她被一座大山壓住了，她被壓在了華山下面。
sentences.pinyin: huà sān huí bù lái le tā bèi yí zuò dà shān yā zhù le tā bèi yā zài le huà shān xià miàn
sentences.english: Hua San couldn’t come back. She was held down by a big mountain. She was held down under Mount Hua.

sentence_translations: The Punishment
Erlong Shen slowly said, “Hua San, if you don’t give me the magic lotus lamp, I’ll take your child back to the heavens.
All the punishment you do not receive will fall on this child. Are you willing to let that happen?”
Tears fell from Hua San’s eyes as she said, “I’ll give you the magic lotus lamp.”
“Very well.” Erlong Shen smiled.
The magic lotus lamp appeared. Hua San waved her hand, and it floated in front of Erlong Shen.
Erlong Shen reached out and grabbed the magic lotus lamp.
“Here you go, the child!” Erlong Shen threw Chengxiang over to Hua San.
Chengxiang was still sleeping. Hua San held him, looked at his chubby face, and was too sad for words.
After a while, she handed the child to Liu Xiang and said with tears in her eyes, ..
.. “Without the magic lotus lantern, I can’t defeat my elder brother.
Our child is in your hands now. You must take good care of him and let him grow up safely.”
Liu Xiang said sadly, “Chengxiang can’t be without his mother, and I can’t be without you.”
Erlong Shen watched them impatiently and said, ..
.. “Hua San! I’m asking you for the last time. Are you willing to go back to the heavens with me?”
Hua San shed no more tears. She looked back at Erlong Shen and gave him her final answer: “I can’t leave my child and my husband.”
Erlong Shen shook his head, raised his sword, and swung it toward Hua San.
Hua San and Erlong Shen started fighting again. They fought back and forth in the black sky.
Soon Liu Xiang couldn’t see them. After a while, a huge cloud came floating over, covering the sky.
Liu Xiang opened his eyes wide to see clearly⁠—it was not a cloud, but a big mountain!
The big mountain came floating from the east and then floated back again.
Then there was a loud bang as if something had been pressed down heavily on the ground.
Then there was silence all around. All the sounds had gone.
Liu Xiang looked anxiously at the black sky and shouted Hua San’s name, but he didn’t hear Hua San’s answer.
The icy voice of Erlong Shen came floating from the distant sky:
“Hua San, this is your punishment for not obeying the rules of heaven. This Mount Hua will be on top of you forever.”
Liu Xiang held Chengxiang and suddenly sat down. He started crying sadly.
Hua San couldn’t come back. She was held down by a big mountain. She was held down under Mount Hua.
